name: Vladimir the Great
summary: Vladimir consolidated and expanded the Rus realm and personally promoted its official adoption of Byzantine Christianity. Later chronicles attribute extensive church patronage, charitable provision and changes in criminal punishment to him, but their moralizing narratives require caution.

sources.title: The Russian Primary Chronicle, Laurentian text, especially annals 980–1015

sources.usedFor: Campaigns, religious orders, charity, school instruction and punishment narrative
